# Which data products serve each information asset

*Generated by `scripts/check.py` from `9-information-assets/information-assets.yml`. Don't edit it: change the source, then run the script.*

A product serves an asset when it publishes its data or an answer built from it. Each product's owner answers for the product; each asset's owner for what its data means.
